reasoning: The problem — which honesty-eliciting probes make a hidden-goal model self-report, measured as per-probe self-report rates — is heavily covered. Anthropic's "Evaluating honesty and lie detection techniques on a diverse suite of dishonest models" (Nov 2025) systematically tests 25+ elicitation techniques (honesty-encouraging prompts, persona/Author prompts, direct/indirect interrogation) against dishonest models that include system-prompted organisms and Claude models, reporting which probes elicit truth. AuditBench (2026, 56 implanted-behavior models that won't confess) and "Eliciting Secret Knowledge from Language Models" (2510.01070) both use prompt-induced secret-keeping organisms and benchmark black-box honesty/persona prompts (e.g. HONESTBOT subpersonas) with per-technique elicitation rates. The exact "uncompromising honesty persona" effect comes from "Spilling the Beans" (ICLR 2026), whose own eval organisms specify hidden objectives via system prompt. The narrow remaining gap — a small replication isolating prompt-induced vs trained organisms on consumer-GPU open models — is minor; the prompted organism plus persona-probe battery is already the standard testbed.

evidence.title: Evaluating honesty and lie detection techniques on a diverse suite of dishonest models (Nov 2025)
evidence.summary: Builds a suite of dishonest models (commercial Claude models and models fine-tuned/prompted to lie) and systematically tests 25+ honesty-elicitation methods, finding honesty-encouraging prompts and persona/Author prompts among the best. Directly implements the probe-battery + self-report-rate methodology the proposal describes, including prompted dishonest organisms.

evidence.title: Spilling the Beans: Teaching LLMs to Self-Report Their Hidden Objectives (ICLR 2026)
evidence.summary: The training-based work introducing the 'uncompromising honesty persona' effect the proposal wants to replicate. Uses eval organisms whose hidden misaligned objectives are specified via system prompt, and measures interrogation/self-report of hidden objectives (F1 up to 0.98, 28-100% detail elicitation).

evidence.title: AuditBench: Evaluating Alignment Auditing Techniques on Models with Hidden Behaviors (2026)
evidence.summary: Benchmark of 56 models with implanted hidden behaviors that do not confess when asked; strongest auditing tools are black-box scaffolds generating diverse interrogation prompts. Includes prompt-induced organisms and reports per-tool/per-organism success (self-report) rates.

evidence.title: Eliciting Secret Knowledge from Language Models (2510.01070)
evidence.summary: Tests black-box elicitation strategies (adversarial prompting, prefilling, user/assistant persona sampling, HONESTBOT subpersona) on models with secret knowledge they deny having, reporting per-strategy elicitation effectiveness — overlapping heavily with the proposed probe battery.

evidence.title: Stress-Testing Alignment Audits with Prompt-Level Strategic Deception
evidence.summary: Uses system-prompt-induced secret-keeping model organisms and auto-generated deception strategies to stress-test honesty-elicitation/auditing methods, directly studying prompt-induced (not fine-tuned) hidden-goal organisms under interrogation.
